title: An owner override lifts the Explore model veto for a spawn he names
why: Degen ledger D7 with D18: guard.py offers an override for an Explore spawn above Sonnet, but call_judge.py refuses that spawn with no override, so the offered remedy never works.
note: Settled with no owner item (triage 21:57 CST): rule roles-sonnet-is-the-ceiling allows any agent above Sonnet "only on my grant for the spawn I name, or by override". So call_judge.py must let the owner override lift the veto, matching guard.py; a test shows a named, overridden Fable Explore spawn passing and an un-overridden one refused. Owner 21:59 CST Nov 12 (chat with the retrospective, relayed 22:01 CST): Q3 a confirms it (store entry explore-veto-override).
